title: PricingModel
description: Pricing Model Schema — a structured, computable representation of a vendor's pricing. Implementations may add top-level fields without breaking conformance with the standard. Part of The Value Project open standard. Schema license: Apache-2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). schema_version.description: Version of this schema that the document conforms to: any 2.x release, for example 2.0.0. Later 2.x releases accept every document that is valid under an earlier 2.x release.

model_id.description: Stable unique identifier of this model. DealConfiguration.model_reference.model_id and InvoiceStatement.model_id refer to it.

anyOf.description: Name of the vendor that publishes this pricing.
ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which this model applies.

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency of the model. A price whose currency is null uses this currency.

required.description: True if mandatory for the product.

features.description: Human-readable features provided by this module.

included_modules.description: Module IDs included in this tier.

overage_policy.description: What happens when entitlements are exhausted.

anyOf.description: Minimum commitment in months. Null if the commitment is not a clean number of months, or if there is no minimum term. Never guessed from a label such as "Annual".

default_for_tier_ids.description: Ids of this product's tiers for which this commitment plan is the preselected option. Empty if none. A tier appears in at most one commitment plan of a product.

anyOf.description: When this rate applies. Null if always.

overage_policy.description: What happens when this credit type is exhausted.

overage_price.description: Price per unit of overage for this credit type. Required (non-null) when overage_policy is pay_as_you_go, and null otherwise. Its credit_type_id is null: the unit is this credit type.

anyOf.description: Percentage of unused units that roll over. Required (non-null) when rollover_policy is partial, and null otherwise.

input_keys.description: Deprecated in 2.0.0. Each strategy shape already names its input in shape.*.metric, which is authoritative. A second list can disagree with it, and nothing says which one wins. Engines read shape.*.metric and ignore input_keys. Validators warn if the two disagree. Earliest removal: two MINOR releases after 2.0.0.

currency.description: Currency of every price in this price book. A price book whose currency differs from the model currency is the only way a calculation ends up in a different currency.
Must equal the currency of the invoice.

calculation_order.description: Deprecated in 2.0.0. The order of phases is fixed by the specification, so a model-supplied order can only contradict it, and its vocabulary is defined nowhere. Engines ignore it. Validators warn when it differs from the phase list. Earliest removal: two MINOR releases after 2.0.0.

discount_application_order.description: Ids of discounts, in the order they are applied. Every discount that can apply to a deal MUST appear, otherwise the model is invalid.

anyOf.description: Number of decimal places. Applied to line totals and adjustment amounts only.

method.description: How a tie rounds. Only half_away_from_zero is defined in 2.0.0.

description.description: Plain text rule statement. Self-contained and actionable by human or LLM. Include specific numbers, names, conditions.

enforcement.description: hard_block=prevents config, warning=allows with flag, info=informational.

dependent_kind.description: What kind of object dependent_id is. Ids are unique within a kind, so a module and a tier may share an id.

requires_kind.description: What kind of object requires_id is.

subject_kind.description: What kind of object subject is.

anyOf.description: What kind of object related_to is. Null if related_to is null.

comparison_grid.description: A grid of features, limits and comparison items (rows) across the tiers of a product. Descriptive only: calculation never reads it, so it is never a second source of price truth. Empty when unused.

anyOf.description: Heading the row is grouped under.

tier_id.description: References products[].tiers[].id of the row's product.

state.description: structured: value holds the content. free_text: only prose is available, in text. not_available: this tier does not have it.

implementation.description: Name of the implementation that declares this profile.

persists.description: Regions the implementation stores and returns unchanged.

derives.description: Regions the implementation computes from other data instead of storing.

discards.description: Regions the implementation drops. It must say so here and may not drop a populated region silently.

anyOf.description: What an implementation keeps, derives and drops. Null if the implementation does not declare one.

type.description: flat=fixed, per_unit=amount×qty, tiered=graduated bands, volume=all units at band price.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amount. Null means the model currency.

anyOf.description: Display label only: what the price is per. Null for flat. Calculation uses credit_type_id, not this text.

credit_type_id.description: References credit_types[].id. The quantity of this credit type is the quantity the price applies to. Required (non-null) for per_unit, tiered and volume module prices; null for flat prices and for credit-package prices.

renewal_behavior.description: reset or accumulate. unknown means the source does not say; an engine reports an indeterminate entitlement and never guesses.

metric_type.description: consumable=depletes/resets, capacity=concurrent limit, cumulative=grows, one_time=granted once.

position.description: Display order among siblings. Dense, zero-based and unique within the immediate parent. Null means array order. For ordering only, never an identifier or a diff key.

id.description: An id: opaque and case-sensitive, lower-case words joined by hyphens. It stays the same across versions of a model while its object exists, and is never reused for a different object.

referential_rules.description: Reference only. Nothing in properties or required refers to it, so it never changes validation. JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express rules that cross arrays, so they are listed here as data in const. A conformant importer, or a validator, runs these rules as a second pass after schema validation. Ids are unique across the model within each kind.

resolves.note: a module of the same product
a tier of the same product
a module of the same product
a tier of the same product
a tier of the row's product

resolves.from: every credit_grant.credit_type_id (modules, tiers, commitment plans, bundles, variant overrides)

DealConfiguration: product_selections[].product_id, tier_id, commitment_plan_id; quantities[].credit_type_id; credit_package_selections[].credit_package_id; bundle_selections[].bundle_id; discount_selections[].discount_id; module_selections[].module_id; negotiated_overrides.price_overrides[].target_id (by target_kind; none for total_deal); negotiated_overrides.credit_grant_overrides[].credit_type_id
resolves.to: the matching object in this model

disjoint.within: the commitment plans of one product
disjoint.rule: No tier id appears in more than one commitment plan.

dense_and_unique_within_parent.rule: Among siblings, either every position is null (array order), or the positions are distinct integers that form 0 to n-1 with no gaps.

derived_agreement.rule: Non-null when price.type is per_unit, tiered or volume. Null when it is flat.
Null. The unit is the credit type itself.
A module marked required is charged whether or not a tier lists it, and once. A module in no tier's included_modules is an add-on.
